_doc: Risk index scoring cases (#266), shared by the PowerShell engine (tests/pester/SIv3-RiskIndexOrder.Tests.ps1) and the C# preview (SI.Management.Web.Tests RiskIndexTests). Index: risk-analysis-detection/riskscore.index.custom.csv (first match wins, in Precedence order). Each case: the finding's six values, the base scores and the 1-based row (in precedence order) that set them (0 = none). Generated by first-match in PowerShell and checked against the v2.2 rule over tests/fixtures/riskindex/riskscore.index.v22.csv when written; the cases of rows 6, 11, 56, 61 (MDE scid-2001 / scid-2000 at Very High) score 3, not the v2.2 2 -- Very High >= High (owner 2026-10-10, REQUIREMENTS #527 (2)).
